question: Zorro had five different flowers A, B, C, D and E. He gave one flower to each of his five friends G, H, I, J and K. J, I and H did not get flowers B and D. K did not get flower B. I did not get flower C or E. J got flower E. Which flower did H get?
solution:
**Given: **Zorro had five different flowers A, B, C, D and E. He gave one flower to each of his five friends G, H, I, J and K.
